name: CRIBBAGE SIX-CARD
description: Cribbage six-card is a card game commonly played with 2-6 using 52 cards. The core rules emphasize variant-specific tactical timing, legal action sequencing, and scoring control.

content.text: Cribbage six-card is a card game commonly played with 2-6 using 52 cards. The core rules emphasize variant-specific tactical timing, legal action sequencing, and scoring control.

Country/Region of Origin: England
Time Period: Early 17th century
Historical Development: Derived from the game noddy; attributed to Sir John Suckling. Rules published in England (Cotgrave 1662, Willughby 1672, Cotton 1674). Spread through the English-speaking world.
Cultural Significance: Britain's national card game; popular in pubs; played in USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand.

Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional

Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included
